title.zh: 原版蓝图查看器:循环还原成 For Each Loop
title.en: Original-card viewer: loops restored to For Each Loop nodes

items.zh: 原版卡牌里的数组循环(如“双日出航线”)以前显示成编译后的一大串计数变量、小于、数组长度、加一、分支节点。现在还原成一个 For Each Loop(或带 Break 的 For Each Loop With Break),连好数组、循环体、完成、数组元素和索引。约 98% 的循环已还原,全库节点总数减少约 17%
items.en: Array loops in original cards (e.g. The Double Sunrise) used to show the compiled counter, Less, Array Length, Add and Branch nodes. They now appear as one For Each Loop (or For Each Loop With Break) with array, loop body, completed, element and index wired. About 98% of loops are restored and the library has about 17% fewer nodes

items.zh: 用字面量数组做的循环(如“军团指挥”的 left_most / right_most),现在是一个 构造数组 节点接 For Each Loop;每圈重新调用一次函数再取元素的循环(如 GetCardsToTheLeft、GetDeckByside),现在只剩一次调用接 For Each Loop
items.en: Loops over a literal array (e.g. Corps Command's left_most / right_most) are now one Make Array node feeding a For Each Loop, and loops whose array comes from a call that the compiler repeats on every pass (GetCardsToTheLeft, GetDeckByside…) show that call once feeding a For Each Loop

items.zh: 事件参数和函数返回值的临时变量读取不再单独悬空,直接连到来源引脚
items.en: Temporary variable reads of event parameters and call results are wired straight to their source pin instead of hanging loose

title.zh: 与/或/比较/运算节点恢复成普通节点样式
title.en: AND / OR / compare / arithmetic nodes look like normal nodes again

items.zh: 与、或、比较(<、>、==)、加减乘除等节点不再用没有标题栏的紧凑样式,改回和其他节点一样的标题栏加引脚行;编辑器和原版蓝图库都一样
items.en: AND, OR, comparison (<, >, ==) and arithmetic nodes no longer use the headerless compact style; they have the same title bar and pin rows as every other node, in the editor and in the original-card viewer

title.zh: 打开着的页面也会自动提示更新
title.en: Open tabs and installed apps now notice updates

items.zh: 以前只在刚打开页面时检查一次更新,页面开着不动就永远不会提示。现在回到页面、窗口重新获得焦点、网络恢复时都会检查(最多每 10 分钟一次),页面一直开着也每 10 分钟检查一次;发现新版本弹出更新提示,同一版本在一次使用中只问一次,正在操作其他对话框时不会打断
items.en: The update check used to run only once right after opening, so a page left open never asked. It now also runs when the tab comes back to the foreground, the window regains focus or the network returns (at most every 10 minutes), and every 10 minutes while open. A release is offered once per session and never interrupts another dialog

items.zh: 新增端到端测试:模拟发布两个构建,验证打开着的页面、缓存的旧页面、设置里的「强制刷新」和顶栏「刷新」都能更新到新版本且卡牌数据不丢
items.en: New end-to-end tests: two builds are published in a simulation and an open tab, a stale cached page, Settings → Force refresh and the top-bar Refresh all reach the new build without losing the card

title.zh: 设置里可以查看版本号
title.en: Version info in Settings

items.zh: 设置最上方新增「版本」:显示当前版本号和构建编号,并与已发布的最新版本对比,提示「已是最新」或「有新版本」;可点「检查更新」或「强制刷新」。本地开发副本会注明未发布构建
items.en: Settings now starts with a Version block: the running version and build id, compared with the published one ("Up to date" / "Update available"), with Check for updates and Force refresh buttons. Local development copies say they are not a published build

title.zh: 原版蓝图库界面与编辑器统一、缩放与连线修复
title.en: Original-card viewer matches the editor; zoom and wiring fixes

items.zh: 原版蓝图库的节点改用编辑器同一套节点样式(标题、引脚、颜色、AND/比较等紧凑运算节点),画布网格、工具栏、缩放条和右侧面板也与编辑器一致;卡牌信息和源指令移到右侧面板,画布更大
items.en: Viewer nodes now use the editor's node styling (titles, pins, colours, compact AND/compare operators); canvas grid, toolbar, zoom pill and right panel match the editor too. Card info and source instructions moved to the right panel so the canvas is larger

items.zh: 修复在查看器里手指碰到节点上的输入框、下拉框或按钮时无法双指缩放;滚轮在节点输入框上也能缩放(输入框获得焦点时除外)
items.en: Fixed pinch-zoom being swallowed when a finger lands on a node's input, dropdown or button; the wheel also zooms over unfocused inputs

items.zh: 库函数调用(Array_Get、Array_Add 等)不再显示无意义的 Target: Default__KismetArrayLibrary 引脚
items.en: Library calls (Array_Get, Array_Add, ...) no longer show the meaningless Target: Default__KismetArrayLibrary pin

items.zh: 调用输出变量(CallFunc_*)现在直接从产生它的引脚连线,不再留下没有来源的游离「获取」节点(例如 数组获取 的 Item 现在直接连到使用它的节点)
items.en: Call-output variables (CallFunc_*) are wired straight from the pin that produces them instead of leaving a getter node connected to nothing (e.g. Array Get's Item now feeds its consumers directly)

items.zh: 按真实节点宽度排列列间距,宽节点不再压到相邻的列;连线按引脚实际位置绘制
items.en: Columns are spaced by real node widths so wide nodes no longer overlap their neighbours; wires are drawn to the pins' real positions

items.zh: 署名:编辑器与修复为 Claude,原版蓝图库为 Codex;更新日志、README、状态栏和查看器页头都有署名
items.en: Credits: editor and fixes by Claude, original-card library by Codex; shown in the changelog, README, status bar and viewer header

title.zh: 查看器节点编辑、跨页面粘贴与事件覆写入口
title.en: Reference node editing, cross-page paste and override access

items.zh: 移除事件图和无输出函数的隐式执行结束节点，保留有输出的函数返回及显式提前返回。
items.en: Remove implicit terminal returns from event graphs and void reference functions, retaining output results and explicit early returns.

items.zh: 查看器支持多选、拖动与复制节点，可追加粘贴到当前编辑器，保留内部连线、类型和必要依赖。
items.en: Select, drag and copy reference nodes into the active editor without replacing the current card; retain internal wires, types and required dependencies.

items.zh: 统一父类事件与覆写入口，查找继承成员，补充101个有UE源码证据的Actor/组件/Widget等事件或函数及5个枚举。
items.en: Unify inherited override/event access and add 101 UE-source-backed Actor/component/Widget and other callbacks, plus five enums.

title.zh: UE 节点可变引脚、紧凑运算与统一配色
title.en: UE variable pins, compact operators and shared colors

items.zh: 按 UE 元数据补齐可扩展运算、Sequence、MultiGate、构造数组、Switch 分支和整数 Select 的引脚增删，保留无关连线及撤销保存。
items.en: Add variable-pin controls for associative operators, Sequence, MultiGate, Make Array, switch cases and integer Select while preserving other wires and undo/save behavior.

items.zh: 节点和引脚使用 UE 5.6 默认编辑器色值，紧凑运算不再显示普通纯函数标题栏；布尔输入改用复选框。
items.en: Share UE 5.6 editor colors, render compact operators without regular function headers and use checkboxes for Boolean inputs.

title.zh: 原版卡牌中文名称与效果搜索
title.en: Chinese card names and effect search

items.zh: 从游戏简体中文本地化资源提取卡名与效果，缺失条目补充并标记参考译文，覆盖全部2019张原版蓝图。
items.en: Use game localization for Chinese names and effects, with marked supplemental translations for missing entries across all 2,019 original Blueprints.

items.zh: 支持中文卡名、多个效果关键词及英文混合搜索，结果显示中文效果摘要并保留英文原文。
items.en: Search Chinese names, multiple effect keywords and English together; show Chinese effect previews while retaining original English text.

title.zh: 展开原版逻辑与手机画布重排
title.en: Expanded original logic and canvas-first mobile navigation

items.zh: 默认展开纯函数、变量读取、运算、数组、结构体和转换节点，保留类型化枚举与函数内置执行分支，可切换精简视图。
items.en: Expand data operations and pure calls by default, preserving typed enums and inline enum execution branches; keep an optional compact view.

items.zh: 手机画布优先显示，选卡、信息及导出按需打开；默认可读比例，支持节点定位和沿连线跳转。
items.en: Give the mobile canvas priority with on-demand library and information panels, readable initial zoom, node navigation and wire following.

title.zh: 蓝图库手机操作与原编辑器风格统一
title.en: Mobile reference navigation and consistent editor styling

items.zh: 蓝图库沿用编辑器深灰界面、蓝色选中状态和语义节点标题。
items.en: Match the editor neutral chrome, blue selection and semantic node headers.

items.zh: 手机改为列表、蓝图、详情面板切换，支持单指平移、双指缩放与触摸控件。
items.en: Add full-width mobile panels, one-finger panning, pinch zoom and touch-sized controls.

title.zh: 原版卡牌蓝图库与类型化枚举 · Codex
title.en: Original-card Blueprint library and typed enums · Codex

items.zh: 收录2019份原版蓝图、5585个函数与80736条顶层源指令，支持搜索、函数导航、类默认值和源指令核对。
items.en: Browse 2,019 original Blueprints, 5,585 functions and 80,736 top-level instructions with search, function navigation, defaults and source inspection.

items.zh: 保留枚举类型，恢复函数内置枚举执行出口，新增Select/Equal/Not Equal枚举节点与引脚类型推断。
items.en: Preserve enum types, recover inline enum execution branches, and add typed Select/Equal/Not Equal enum nodes.

items.zh: 辅助表达式和高级参数默认折叠，支持复制到工作区与导出，保留确定的数据连线与执行回边。
items.en: Fold helper expressions and advanced inputs by default; copy to the workspace or export while preserving stable data links and execution back-edges.

items.zh: 修复压缩ZIP导入时将未压缩大小当作压缩大小读取的问题。
items.en: Fix deflated ZIP imports reading the uncompressed size instead of the compressed size.

title.zh: 敌方阵营可搜到、枚举分支函数展开成执行输出
title.en: Find the enemy side; enum-branch functions expand into execution outputs

items.zh: 「获取相反阵营」改名为「获取敌方阵营」(目标默认 Self 的卡牌函数 GetOppositeSide);搜「敌方阵营」可同时找到 GetOppositeSide、GetOpponentSide、GetTheOtherSide
items.en: GetOppositeSide is now labelled "获取敌方阵营" (target defaults to Self); searching 敌方阵营 also lists GetOpponentSide and GetTheOtherSide

items.zh: WhichChooseOne、WhichStrategy、BranchOnPlatformType、EnumCompare 系列等输出名为 Branches 的函数,现在像 UE 一样每个枚举值一个执行输出(如 Card_0 / Card_1)
items.en: Functions whose output is an enum named Branches (WhichChooseOne, WhichStrategy, BranchOnPlatformType, the EnumCompare family) now show one execution output per value (e.g. Card_0 / Card_1) like Unreal

items.zh: 所有节点都能用拆开单词的名字搜索,例如「Which Choose One」
items.en: Every node can be searched by its split-up name, e.g. "Which Choose One"

title.zh: 修复 Switch on Enum 引脚左右错位
title.en: Switch on Enum pins on the right sides

items.zh: 枚举下拉框占了节点的一个格子,把执行/选择输入挤到了右边、枚举值输出跑到了左边,看起来像没有可以接的输入引脚;现在下拉框独占一行,输入在左、各枚举值输出在右
items.en: The enum picker used up a grid cell and pushed the Exec/Selection inputs to the right and the case outputs to the left, so there seemed to be no input pin; the picker now has its own row, inputs on the left and one output per value on the right

title.zh: 只保留一个「Switch on Enum」
title.en: One Switch on Enum, like Unreal

items.zh: 节点库里只有一个「按枚举切换 / Switch on Enum」;放下后在节点上选枚举(或把枚举连到 Selection 自动识别),执行输出随枚举值变化。去掉了上一版按枚举各生成一个的 37 个节点
items.en: The palette has a single Switch on Enum. Pick the enum on the node (or wire an enum into Selection) and its execution outputs follow the values. The 37 per-enum nodes of the previous version are gone

title.zh: 新增「按枚举切换」(Switch on Enum)
title.en: Switch on Enum nodes

items.zh: 为每个枚举生成一个「Switch on <枚举名>」节点,每个枚举值一个执行输出,搜索 Switch on Enum 可找到全部 37 个(如 Switch on EFactionEnum)
items.en: A Switch on <enum> node for every enum, with one execution output per value; search "Switch on Enum" to list all 37 (e.g. Switch on EFactionEnum)

title.zh: 可安装为 Windows 应用
title.en: Install as a Windows app

items.zh: 在 Windows 的 Chrome / Edge 上打开时,会主动弹出「安装为 Windows 应用」提示(独立窗口 + 开始菜单图标);可选「以后再说」(两周内不再提示)或「不再提示」
items.en: On Windows Chrome/Edge an "Install as a Windows app" offer pops up (own window + Start-menu icon); choose Not now (14 days) or Never

items.zh: 设置里随时可以点「安装为应用…」;新增网页应用清单、图标和一个不缓存任何内容的最小 service worker
items.en: Settings has an "Install as app…" button any time; adds a web app manifest, icons and a minimal service worker that caches nothing

title.zh: 设置里可关闭右键拖动平移
title.en: Setting to turn off right-drag panning

items.zh: 设置里新增「鼠标右键拖动空白处平移」开关;浏览器的鼠标手势/画笔/截图工具和右键拖动冲突时可关闭,仍可用空格+左键、中键或 Alt+左键平移
items.en: New setting "Right-drag on empty canvas pans". Turn it off if browser mouse gestures / draw / capture tools react to right-drag; Space+left, middle mouse or Alt+left still pan

items.zh: 右键按下时尽量阻止浏览器自己的手势
items.en: Right-button press now asks the browser not to start its own gestures

title.zh: 新增 Cast To BP_CardFunctions 等 5 个蓝图类转换
title.en: Cast To BP_CardFunctions and 4 more game Blueprint classes

items.zh: 节点库新增 Cast To:BP_CardFunctions、BP_PlayerController、BP_Logic、BP_GameState_Battle、BP_KardsGameInstance(游戏自带的蓝图类,父类分别是 ACardFunctionsStub、AKardsPlayerController、AkardsGameMode、AkardsGameState、UKardsGameInstance2),搜索 BP_ 即可找到
items.en: Added Cast To BP_CardFunctions, BP_PlayerController, BP_Logic, BP_GameState_Battle and BP_KardsGameInstance (the game's own Blueprint classes; parents ACardFunctionsStub, AKardsPlayerController, AkardsGameMode, AkardsGameState, UKardsGameInstance2); search for BP_

title.zh: 电脑上鼠标右键拖动平移
title.en: Right-drag pans on desktop

items.zh: 鼠标右键在空白处按住拖动即可平移画布(显示抓手);原地单击右键仍然打开节点菜单
items.en: Dragging with the right mouse button on empty canvas pans it (grab cursor); a plain right-click still opens the node menu

items.zh: 左键在空白处拖动是框选;画布上禁止浏览器自带的文字选中和拖拽,不再抢手势
items.en: Left-drag on empty canvas is box select; the browser's own text selection and dragging no longer steal the gesture

title.zh: 缩小到 20% 以下才简化节点
title.en: Simplify nodes only below 20% zoom

items.zh: 节点的文字和输入框改为缩放低于 20% 时才隐藏,这样 20%–50% 之间仍能看清引脚
items.en: Labels and inputs are now hidden only below 20% zoom, so pins stay readable between 20% and 50%

title.zh: 大图更流畅:屏幕外不绘制、缩小时简化
title.en: Big graphs: off-screen culling and zoomed-out simplification

items.zh: 屏幕外的节点不再绘制(保留布局,连线不受影响)
items.en: Nodes outside the screen are not painted (layout is kept, so wires are unaffected)

items.zh: 缩放低于 50% 时只画节点标题、端口和连线,隐藏文字与输入框
items.en: Below 50% zoom only titles, pins and wires are painted; labels and inputs are hidden

title.zh: 平移/缩放更跟手
title.en: Smoother pan and zoom

items.zh: 平移、缩放、双指捏合时,小地图只移动视野框,不再每帧重建全部节点方块;每帧最多重画一次
items.en: Panning, zooming and pinching only move the minimap's view frame instead of rebuilding every node rectangle, at most once per frame

items.zh: 手势期间把画布提升为独立图层
items.en: The canvas gets its own layer while a gesture is in progress

title.zh: 节点多了不再卡
title.en: Smoother with many nodes

items.zh: 拖动节点时只更新相连的连线,且不再每帧强制重新布局;连线/小地图每帧最多重画一次
items.en: Dragging nodes only moves the wires attached to them, without forced layouts; wires and minimap redraw at most once per frame

items.zh: 修改数值、保存时不再每次都滚动并重建左侧卡牌列表(这是最大的卡顿来源)
items.en: Editing a value or saving no longer rebuilds and scrolls the card list every time (the biggest source of lag)

items.zh: 节点尺寸、端口位置一次性测量并共享;松手后不再整页重绘
items.en: Node sizes and pin positions are measured once per pass; dropping a node no longer re-renders everything

title.zh: 修复改数值后连线错位
title.en: Wires stay on their pins after editing a value

items.zh: 连线位置改为相对画布本身测量,不再受手机键盘/焦点造成的画布滚动影响
items.en: Wire positions are measured against the canvas itself, so keyboard- or focus-induced scrolling no longer misplaces them

items.zh: 输入框确认、失焦、窗口或键盘尺寸变化后自动重画连线
items.en: Wires are redrawn after confirming/leaving an input and when the window or keyboard resizes

title.zh: 补齐 UE 常用基础节点
title.en: The everyday Unreal nodes

items.zh: 数学:绝对值、符号、取余、是否在范围内、幂、平方根、平方、四舍五入/向下/向上/截断取整、小数部分、正弦/余弦/正切、线性插值、区间映射、近似相等
items.en: Math: Abs, Sign, Modulo, In Range, Power, Sqrt, Square, Round/Floor/Ceil/Truncate, Fraction, Sin/Cos/Tan, Lerp, Map Range Clamped, Nearly Equal

items.zh: 随机:随机整数、范围内随机整数、随机浮点、范围内随机浮点、随机布尔、按概率随机布尔、数组随机元素
items.en: Random: Random Integer (in range), Random Float (in range), Random Bool (with weight), Random array item

items.zh: 任意类型:等于 / 不等于 / 选择可以用于枚举、名称、字符串、布尔、对象,类型由连线决定
items.en: Any type: Equal / Not Equal / Select work on enums, names, strings, booleans and objects; the type comes from the wire

items.zh: 字符串:长度、大小写、包含、开头/结尾、替换、去空白、左/右/中间截取、为空、忽略大小写比较、查找、拆分、合并数组
items.en: Strings: Len, case, Contains, Starts/Ends With, Replace, Trim, Left/Right/Mid, Is Empty, case-insensitive compare, Find, Parse Into Array, Join

items.zh: 向量与旋转:加、减、乘浮点、长度、归一化、距离、点乘、叉乘、构造/拆分旋转;转换:字符串↔数字、布尔转整数、转文本等;字面值节点;游戏时间
items.en: Vectors and rotators, more conversions (String to Integer/Float, Boolean to Integer, to Text, …), Make Literal nodes and game time

items.zh: 流程:3 路/4 路序列、多路门、按字符串/名称分支;所有节点的英文名改成 UE 的叫法,例如 Add (Integer)、To String (Integer)
items.en: Flow: Sequence (3)/(4), MultiGate, Switch on String/Name; every built-in now shows Unreal's English name, e.g. Add (Integer), To String (Integer)

title.zh: 补全数组基础节点
title.en: The basic array nodes, completed

items.zh: 新增:数组为空 / 数组不为空、第一个元素、最后一个元素
items.en: New: Is Empty / Is Not Empty, First Item, Last Item

items.zh: 新增:插入、按下标移除、设置数组元素、追加数组、反转、打乱、交换两个元素、调整数组长度;和之前的长度、获取、添加、包含、查找、移除、清空一起,覆盖 UE 的常用数组操作,全部支持任意元素类型
items.en: New: Insert, Remove Index, Set Array Elem, Append Array, Reverse, Shuffle, Swap, Resize; together with Length, Get, Add, Contains, Find, Remove and Clear they cover Unreal's usual array operations, all for any element type

title.zh: 多条执行流可以接到同一个执行输入
title.en: Several execution flows can join one execution input

items.zh: 和 UE 一样:多个执行输出可以接到同一个执行输入(例如分支的两条路最后都接到同一个 Return Node、同一个 Change Attack);每个执行输出仍然只连向一处,数据输入仍然只接受一条连线
items.en: Like Unreal: several execution outputs can feed one execution input (e.g. both branches ending in the same Return Node or the same Change Attack); an execution output still leads to one place and a data input still takes one wire

items.zh: 导入文件时也接受这种汇合;整理布局能正常处理
items.en: Files with such joins import fine, and Arrange handles them

title.zh: 手机选择条变小、粘贴按钮不再一直挡视野
title.en: Smaller phone selection bar, Paste no longer in the way

items.zh: 选择操作条恢复成一排小按钮(「取消选择」缩短为「取消」);没选中节点时,「粘贴」只在复制后或切换图表/卡牌后的几秒内以一个小按钮出现在左下角,然后自动消失
items.en: The selection bar is back to one row of small buttons; with nothing selected, Paste shows as a small chip in the corner for a few seconds after copying or switching graph/card, then goes away

title.zh: 返回节点可复制粘贴、手机选择条不再溢出
title.en: Return Nodes can be copied, phone selection bar fits the screen

items.zh: 返回节点(Return Node)也能复制、剪切、粘贴和 Ctrl+D 复制一份:粘贴出来的是这个函数的额外返回节点;粘贴到另一个函数里会用那个函数自己的输出引脚;原来的返回节点仍然锁定不能删除
items.en: Return Nodes can be copied, cut, pasted and duplicated (Ctrl+D): the paste is an extra Return Node using the target function's own outputs; the original stays locked

items.zh: 手机底部的选择操作条之前比屏幕还宽,两头的按钮(详情、删除)会被挤出屏幕;现在按屏幕宽度排布,放不下就换行,「复制」「粘贴」一直看得到
items.en: The phone selection bar used to be wider than the screen so the end buttons were cut off; it now fits the width and wraps, so Copy and Paste are always visible

title.zh: 复制 / 粘贴 / 剪切节点
title.en: Copy, paste and cut nodes

items.zh: 新增复制、粘贴、剪切:Ctrl/Cmd+C、V、X,顶部菜单有「复制」「粘贴」按钮;手机上选中节点后底部操作条有「复制」「粘贴」,没选中时只显示「粘贴」
items.en: New Copy, Paste and Cut: Ctrl/Cmd+C, V, X, Copy/Paste buttons in the menu bar, and Copy/Paste in the phone selection bar (only Paste when nothing is selected)

items.zh: 粘贴会带上节点之间的连线,放在鼠标位置(手机放在画面中央),连续粘贴会错开;可以粘贴到别的图表、别的卡牌甚至别的标签页,放不进去的节点(如事件放进函数图)会跳过并提示
items.en: Pasting keeps the wires between nodes and puts them at the mouse (screen centre on phones); repeated pastes are staggered; works across graphs, cards and tabs, and skips nodes that cannot go there (e.g. events in a function graph)

items.zh: 原来的「复制」改名为「副本」(Ctrl+D 原地复制一份)
items.en: The old Copy is now called Duplicate (Ctrl+D makes a copy next to the original)

title.zh: 数组节点支持任意类型
title.en: Array nodes work with any element type

items.zh: 数组节点改成通配符:接上任意类型的数组或元素后,所有引脚自动变成那个类型(整数、字符串、BaseCardObject、枚举、任意对象都行),断开后恢复成通配符
items.en: Array nodes are now wildcards: wire any array or element and every pin takes that type (integers, strings, BaseCardObject, enums, any object); unplug and they go back to wildcard

items.zh: 新增「数组包含元素」(Contains Item):判断一个 BaseCardObject 是否在数组里,返回 true/false;还有查找元素下标(没有返回 -1)、添加不重复元素、移除数组元素、清空数组、最后一个下标、下标是否有效
items.en: New Contains Item (true/false), Find Item (index, -1 when missing), Add Unique, Remove Item, Clear, Last Index and Is Valid Index

items.zh: 从数组引脚拖线到空白处,会列出这些数组节点;英文名改成 UE 的叫法(Contains Item、For Each Loop 等)
items.en: Dragging a wire from an array pin to empty space lists these array nodes; English names follow Unreal (Contains Item, For Each Loop, …)

title.zh: 防丢数据加固:多标签页、半更新缓存、本地备份
title.en: Data-safety hardening: several tabs, half-updated caches, local backup

items.zh: 修复多个标签页互相覆盖:另一个标签页保存后会自动载入最新内容,空闲或关闭的标签页不再写回旧数据;工作区列表不再因为另一个标签页而丢卡牌,已经掉出列表的卡牌会自动找回
items.en: Fixed tabs overwriting each other: a tab now picks up what another tab saved, idle or closing tabs no longer write old data back, the workspace list no longer drops cards, and cards that fell out of the list are recovered automatically

items.zh: 防止「新旧文件混用」:每个发布版本的文件都带版本号,页面和脚本对不上时自动重新打开最新版;页面没能启动时 8 秒后自动重试,仍不行会出现「导出本地备份 / 强制刷新」
items.en: No more mixed old and new files: every published file is pinned to its build, a page/script mismatch reopens the latest build, and if the app does not start a Back up / Reload bar appears after 8 seconds

items.zh: 设置里新增「导出全部本地数据」和「恢复备份」,即使有卡牌打不开也能原样导出
items.en: Settings now has Export all local data and Restore backup, which work even when a card cannot be opened

items.zh: 启动时某张卡牌读不出来,不再用空白项目盖住它:改为尝试其他卡牌并保留原数据
items.en: If a card cannot be read at start-up it is kept as it is and other cards are tried, instead of being replaced by a blank project

items.zh: 手机上在详情面板里从一个输入框点到下一个时,不再丢失焦点、键盘不再收起
items.en: On phones, tapping from one field of the Details panel to the next no longer drops focus or closes the keyboard

title.zh: 手机上能关闭详情和工作区
title.en: Close buttons for the phone drawers

items.zh: 详情面板右上角新增「✕」关闭按钮,滚动时也固定在顶部;左侧工作区抽屉顶部新增「✕ 关闭」;按 Esc 也能关
items.en: The Details panel has a ✕ close button that stays at the top while scrolling; the workspace drawer has a ✕ Close bar; Esc closes both

title.zh: 卡牌信息:行动花费、稀有度、单位类型
title.en: Card data: operation cost, rarity, unit types

items.zh: 新增「行动花费」(单位的行动费用),旧文件默认 1
items.en: New Operation cost field; older files default to 1

items.zh: 稀有度只留游戏里的四档和无稀有度:普通(铁)、稀有(铜)、特殊(银)、精英(金),卡牌预览的边框颜色跟着变
items.en: Rarity now offers the game's four tiers plus none: Standard (iron), Limited (copper), Special (silver), Elite (gold); the preview frame follows the colour

items.zh: 卡牌类型补全并加中文:步兵、坦克、炮兵、战斗机、轰炸机、防空炮、反坦克炮、坦克歼击车、指令、反制、地点、万能牌
items.en: Card types are complete and labelled: infantry, tank, artillery, fighter, bomber, anti-air, anti-tank, tank destroyer, order, countermeasure, location, wildcard

title.zh: 手机上找到卡牌信息
title.en: Card data is easy to find on phones

items.zh: 手机上画布工具栏的最右边按钮不再被挤出屏幕:整理、多选只显示图标,新增带文字的「详情」按钮,点它打开卡牌信息、类默认值
items.en: On phones the right-most canvas buttons no longer fall off the screen: Arrange and Multi show icons only, and a labelled Details button opens card data and class defaults

items.zh: 左侧抽屉的「我的蓝图」顶部新增「卡牌信息」入口,点一下直接打开并滚到卡牌信息
items.en: The left drawer now has a Card Data entry at the top of My Blueprint that opens the details panel right at the card data

title.zh: 类默认值、Reason 中文
title.en: Class Defaults, Chinese Reason texts

items.zh: 新增「类默认值」:在「我的蓝图」顶部点开,或在详情面板里,编辑父类 UBaseCardObject 的上百个属性默认值(开关、数字、枚举、文本、列表),只保存改过的,可一键恢复,会导出
items.en: New Class Defaults: open it at the top of My Blueprint or in the Details panel to edit the default values of the parent's properties (switches, numbers, enums, text, lists); only changed values are saved, can be reset and are exported

items.zh: Reason 列表的 125 个键全部加了中文,搜索中文或英文都行
items.en: All 125 Reason keys now have Chinese texts; search works in both languages

title.zh: 多个返回节点、标签栏修复、Reason 选择器
title.en: Multiple Return Nodes, tab strip fix, Reason picker

items.zh: 函数可以有多个返回节点:在函数图里添加「Return Node」,每条执行路径各接一个;额外的可以删除,原来的那个保留
items.en: Functions can have several Return Nodes: add Return Node in a function graph, one per exit path; extra ones can be deleted, the original stays

items.zh: 重载很多函数时,顶部标签栏不再溢出:长名字显示省略号,可以横向滚动/滚轮滚动,当前标签自动滚到可见位置,「＋」固定在右侧
items.en: With many overrides the tab strip no longer overflows: long names are ellipsised, it scrolls sideways (also with the wheel), the active tab scrolls into view and + stays on the right

items.zh: CanPlayFromHand、CanBeTargetted、CanOtherCardBeTargetted 的 Reason:点击后可以从游戏文本表 textNotifications 的 125 个键里搜索选择,也可以自己写键
items.en: Reason of CanPlayFromHand, CanBeTargetted and CanOtherCardBeTargetted: click to search and pick one of the 125 textNotifications keys, or type your own

items.zh: 新增节点按自身大小找空位,不再压在其他节点上
items.en: New nodes find a free spot using their own size, so they no longer land on other nodes

title.zh: 重载函数列表:按返回节点区分、可搜索
title.en: Override list: split by Return Node, searchable

items.zh: BaseCardObject 里有返回节点(有输出)的才是重载函数,共 32 个;没有输出的(如 OnStartOfTurn、CampaignOnEndOfGame)是事件
items.en: In BaseCardObject only members with a Return Node (outputs) are override functions (32); ones without (e.g. OnStartOfTurn, CampaignOnEndOfGame) are Events

items.zh: 重载父类函数窗口新增搜索(英文名、中文名、参数),已重载的会标出,再选直接跳转
items.en: The Override window now has search (English name, Chinese name, parameters); overridden ones are marked and jump to the existing graph

title.zh: 区分重载函数与事件
title.en: Override functions are no longer treated as Events

items.zh: 带输出参数的 On… 函数(如 OnCardDealDamage_ModifyDamageDealt、OnBeforeRetreat)现在按 UE 规则是可重载的函数,不再当作事件;输出参数成为函数的返回值
items.en: On… functions that have output parameters (e.g. OnCardDealDamage_ModifyDamageDealt, OnBeforeRetreat) are now overridable functions, as in Unreal, not Events; their outputs become the function's return values

items.zh: 只有没有输出参数的通知(如 OnStartOfTurn)才是事件,放在事件图里
items.en: Only notifications without outputs (e.g. OnStartOfTurn) stay Events in the Event Graph

title.zh: 整理更符合阅读习惯
title.en: Arrange now follows how people read a blueprint

items.zh: 执行流从左到右;分支(True/False、Then 0/1)按引脚顺序从上到下排列,并与来源引脚对齐
items.en: Execution flows left to right; branches (True/False, Then 0/1) stack in pin order, aligned with their source pin

items.zh: 纯数据节点(如变量、查询)放在使用它的节点左侧,并对齐对应输入引脚
items.en: Pure value nodes sit just left of the node that uses them, lined up with the input pin

items.zh: 互不相连的逻辑各占一条横带;没有连线的节点整齐排成网格放在最下方
items.en: Unconnected graphs get their own band; nodes without wires are parked in a tidy grid below

title.zh: 新节点不再叠放、新增整理按钮
title.en: New nodes no longer stack, Arrange button

items.zh: 新增节点会自动放在不遮挡其他节点的空位上
items.en: New nodes are placed on a free spot instead of on top of other nodes

items.zh: 画布工具栏新增「整理」:按连线方向分列排布节点,叠在一起的节点会被拆开(可撤销)
items.en: New Arrange button: lays nodes out in columns by flow direction and separates stacked nodes (undoable)

title.zh: 框选与多选、阻止长按复制
title.en: Box select, multi-select, block long-press copy

items.zh: 鼠标在空白处拖动会出现白色选框,框住的节点被选中,可删除/复制;空格、中键或 Alt 拖动仍可平移
items.en: Dragging on empty canvas draws a white box and selects the nodes inside; Space, middle mouse or Alt still pans

items.zh: 新增「多选」按钮:开启后点节点选中、再点取消,拖空白处也可框选;选中的节点有黄色边框
items.en: New Multi button: tap nodes to select and tap again to deselect, drag on empty space to box-select; selected nodes get a yellow frame

items.zh: 新增设置(⚙):可阻止长按选中文字和复制菜单,也可把鼠标拖动改回平移
items.en: New Settings (⚙): block long-press text selection and the copy menu, or switch mouse drag back to panning

title.zh: 更密的节点列表与更小的缩放
title.en: Denser node lists and smaller zoom

items.zh: 节点库和添加节点窗口改为一行一个节点,一屏能看到更多
items.en: The node library and Add Node window list one node per line, so many more fit on screen

items.zh: 画布最小缩放从 20% 降到 5%
items.en: Canvas zoom can now go down to 5% (was 20%)

items.zh: 分类标签改为单行横向滚动,「更多」按钮更紧凑
items.en: Category chips scroll in a single row and the Show more bar is compact

title.zh: 手机端工作区入口
title.en: Workspace entry on phones

items.zh: 手机上画布左上方的按钮现在显示当前卡牌名，点它打开左侧的工作区、我的蓝图和节点库
items.en: On phones the button at the top left of the canvas now shows the current card name; tap it to open the workspace, blueprint and palette

title.zh: 更新提醒
title.en: Update reminder

items.zh: 每次打开网页会检查是否有新版本，有的话弹窗说明更新内容，可以选择立即更新或暂不更新
items.en: The page checks for a newer version every time it opens and asks whether to update, with a summary of what changed

items.zh: 修复「刷新」按钮漏刷新部分文件，可能导致刷新后仍是旧版本的问题
items.en: Fixed the Refresh button skipping some files, which could leave parts of the old version in place

title.zh: 多卡牌工作区与统一导出
title.en: Workspace and unified export

items.zh: 左侧新增「工作区」：同时保存多张卡牌，可新建、导入、切换、重命名、复制、删除
items.en: New Workspace on the left: keep several cards, with new / import / switch / rename / duplicate / delete

items.zh: 导出按钮合并为一个，带倒三角切换格式：蓝图文件、SVG、PNG、工作区全部（ZIP）
items.en: One Export button with a format switch: blueprint file, SVG, PNG or all cards (ZIP)

items.zh: PNG 倍率可选 1×–4× 或手填 0.5–8；支持一次导入多个文件和 ZIP
items.en: PNG scale 1×–4× or custom 0.5–8; import several files or a ZIP at once

title.zh: 手机顶栏适配
title.en: Phone header fixes

items.zh: 顶栏和菜单栏不再超出手机屏幕，窄屏下菜单按钮只显示一种语言
items.en: The top bar and menu bar no longer run off phone screens; menu buttons show one language on narrow screens

title.zh: 节点体验
title.en: Node experience

items.zh: 节点按复杂度分档大小：简单数据节点更小，多参数函数节点更大更好连线
items.en: Nodes scale with complexity: small data nodes, roomier busy function nodes

items.zh: Target 规则与 UE 一致：属于本蓝图的函数默认 Self 并隐藏，其他函数必须连线
items.en: Target works like Unreal: Self for this blueprint's own functions (hidden), required wire otherwise

items.zh: 节点上的数值、枚举、布尔值可以直接编辑；选择器与节点库支持「显示更多」
items.en: Edit numbers, enums and booleans right on the node; Show more in the picker and palette

title.zh: UE 式蓝图结构
title.en: Unreal-style blueprint structure

items.zh: 唯一的 EventGraph，加上函数（自定义/重载）、宏、变量、局部变量、自定义事件、事件分发器
items.en: A single EventGraph plus functions (custom / override), macros, variables, local variables, custom events and event dispatchers

items.zh: 导出文件升级为版本 2，包含资源信息、依赖和统计；旧版本文件不再兼容
items.en: Export format version 2 with asset info, dependencies and stats; version 1 files are no longer supported
